semantics.out_xor: XOR of all 100 input bits, equivalently odd parity for binary inputs
semantics.timing: Combinational response without added latency or state, from original combinational circuit requirement
semantics.clock_reset_initialization: No clock or reset ports and no stored initialization state specified; outputs follow current inputs after combinational settling

numeric.operations: Boolean gates; no signed arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow
numeric.four_state: Use standard SystemVerilog gate reduction semantics; original problem does not explicitly specify X/Z behavior

verification.oracle: Independent bit-count oracle for binary vectors, derived from original AND/OR/XOR definitions
verification.coverage: All-zero/all-one, every single-one and single-zero position, all population counts 0 through 100, alternating patterns, random vectors, supplemental X/Z gate propagation
verification.sampling: Drive inputs and wait one simulation time unit for combinational settling before comparisons
verification.success: PASS line only after all cases; run python3 dev_check.py --label initial

specification_ambiguities: X/Z inputs are not explicitly discussed; standard SystemVerilog gate semantics are used and checked supplementally.
